data.one_liner: Typesafe SQLite annotations for the Floor ORM.
data.what_it_does: Provides annotations that generate type‑safe, reactive SQLite code for Flutter. It is a low‑level part of the Floor library and should be used via the main floor package.
use_when: You need a lightweight, reactive SQLite solution with compile‑time safety.
You prefer code generation over manual SQL strings.
You are already using the floor package for database access.
avoid_when: You want a pure runtime ORM like drift or sqflite without code generation.
You need advanced features such as migrations or complex queries beyond what Floor offers.
weaknesses: Must be used together with the floor package
data.setup_notes: Add floor_annotation to dev_dependencies, run `flutter pub run build_runner build` after importing floor in your project.

alternatives.name: floor
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the full ORM including annotations and runtime

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a richer feature set and advanced migrations

alternatives.name: sqflite_common
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple SQLite wrapper without code generation
